verdicts.evidence: moisses89 flagged the race at workspace.relayer.ts:98 and the author replied "Applied". Commit e3685d072 ("reserve the allowance in one transaction with its check") replaces the assertWithinQuota→relay→recordUsage sequence that existed at 2bdf6ac8d.
At 2bdf6ac8d, entitlements.service.ts:195 logged a warn and returned when grant.counter was null. Commit abc0f045b makes it throw instead, and the author replied that items 1, 2, 4 and 5 were done.

The author turned down the Promise.all change at workspace.relayer.ts:102. They said the checks run in order from cheapest to most expensive, so a request that will be rejected never reaches Tenderly, and running them together would make the 403 vs 402 result depend on timing.
The author answered bot item 6 by saying a typo wouldn't compile because the parameter is typed SimulatedRelayer. `relayer: 'workspace'` is still in workspace.relayer.ts:165 at HEAD.
space-relay.module.ts:31-33 wrapped AuthModule, SpacesModule and UsersModule in forwardRef at 2bdf6ac8d. Commit abc0f045b switches them to plain imports (the author's reply lists item 4 as done).
At 2bdf6ac8d, isEventMeteredFeature in entitlements.constants.ts:36-38 returned `boolean`. The author replied "Done", and commit 9124d9034 narrows the return type.
At 2bdf6ac8d, entitlements.service.ts:292 built `const feature = { key: args.featureKey }`. Commit abc0f045b replaces it with isStockMeteredFeatureKey(args.featureKey).

At 2bdf6ac8d, space-relay.controller.ts:94-103 repeated the relay filter list. The author replied "Applied", and commit ff371574b moves the shared filters into relay-calldata.exception-filters.ts, which both controllers now use.
